keyPoints.en: Sarawak was under Brunei; Sabah under Brunei (west and north) and Sulu (east), ruled through pangeran, datu and local chiefs.
keyPoints.bm: Sarawak di bawah Brunei; Sabah di bawah Brunei (barat dan utara) dan Sulu (timur), ditadbir melalui pangeran, datu dan ketua tempatan.

keyPoints.en: James Brooke helped Pangeran Muda Hashim end a revolt and became Rajah in 1841.
keyPoints.bm: James Brooke membantu Pangeran Muda Hashim menamatkan pemberontakan dan menjadi Raja pada 1841.

keyPoints.en: Expansion from Brunei: Mukah/Bintulu 1861, Baram 1882, Trusan 1885, Limbang 1890, Lawas 1905. Rajahs: James → Charles (1868) → Vyner (1917).
keyPoints.bm: Peluasan daripada Brunei: Mukah/Bintulu 1861, Baram 1882, Trusan 1885, Limbang 1890, Lawas 1905. Raja: James → Charles (1868) → Vyner (1917).

keyPoints.en: Overbeck and Dent got rights from Brunei and Sulu (1877–1878); British North Borneo Company received a royal charter in 1881.
keyPoints.bm: Overbeck dan Dent mendapat hak daripada Brunei dan Sulu (1877–1878); Syarikat Borneo Utara British menerima piagam diraja pada 1881.

keyPoints.en: The company sought profit through taxes and resources.
keyPoints.bm: Syarikat mencari keuntungan melalui cukai dan sumber.

keyPoints.en: Sarawak: absolute Rajah, Supreme Council (1855), Council Negri (1867), Divisions under Residents, local chiefs.
keyPoints.bm: Sarawak: Raja berkuasa mutlak, Majlis Tertinggi (1855), Council Negri (1867), Bahagian di bawah Residen, ketua tempatan.

keyPoints.en: Sabah: Court of Directors in London, Governor, Residents, native chiefs. Both became Crown Colonies in 1946.
keyPoints.bm: Sabah: Lembaga Pengarah di London, Gabenor, Residen, ketua anak negeri. Kedua-duanya menjadi Tanah Jajahan Mahkota pada 1946.
